interpretations: For each `Laboratory.ID`, divide the mean of its nonmissing `HGB` values by the mean of its nonmissing `HCT` values. Compute the mean of all defined patient ratios and keep ratios strictly above it. Compute the mean ratio of that kept group and keep ratios strictly above that second mean. Return one unrounded row containing, for the final patients, the mean ratio, the mean difference from the overall mean, and the mean difference from the second mean
queries:
WITH patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio
    FROM patient_ratios
),
second AS (
    SELECT AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio
    FROM patient_ratios AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE p.ratio > o.mean_ratio
)
SELECT
    AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio,
    AVG(p.ratio - o.mean_ratio) AS mean_difference_from_overall,
    AVG(p.ratio - s.mean_ratio) AS mean_difference_from_second
FROM patient_ratios AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
CROSS JOIN second AS s
WHERE p.ratio > s.mean_ratio
